reviews.text: I absolutely loved visiting Hue Walking Street. The area was a series of streets closed off to the usual traffic. In place, market stalls were set up along side the regular restaurants and souvenir shops. I was very lucky as I didn't realise it was only open on the weekend. I found the atmosphere to be very exciting and vibrant. Unlike some other walking streets I visited, this had a wholesome, family friendly appeal but also catered to wider audiences with bars and drinking venues. There was a lot to eat and drink amongst the streets and it was all relatively inexpensive. Souvenirs were also great value too. I would highly recommend coming to visit.

When you are looking for food and fun.  Check out Hue walking street on a Saturday or Sunday night.  Streets are closed on these nights from 6pm.  It becomes alive with loud music and people.  Lots of restaurants, shops, massages, mini marts, pharmacy and more.  Kids playing soccer (football) and badminton in the streets were a  highlight.  So much fun and energy.

Hue Walking Street is such a fun and lively place to visit. The atmosphere is super vibrant, especially in the evening. There are many bars and restaurants on higher floors where you can enjoy drinks or food while overlooking the walking street below, and all at very reasonable prices.

You’ll find everything here: street performances, hotels, restaurants, bars, shops, pharmacies, pool table bars… it really has it all.

The energy continues late into the night (or early morning!), making it a great place to hang out, explore, and soak up the local vibe.

Definitely worth a visit when you’re in Hue!

We happened to be there because of a restaurant we wanted to dine in. Was pleasantly surprised that the whole area was closed to vehicles. It was indeed interesting as there are lots of eateries and pubs with seats outside. The weather in February is cool so dining and drinking outdoors is very pleasant. Love the atmosphere.

Although the experience and atmosphere is not the same as in Hoi An, it’s good to also have these motorbike- and car-free walking streets in Hue. That way you can stroll safely through these streets and explore the nice restaurants and souvenir shops / vendors. Mind you though that there is also quite some noise and loud music coming from different bars.

Must visit this place if you’re in Hue.
Vibrant, loud and great fun - although we were there during TET celebrations (Lunar New Year).

Great vibe, lots of choice in terms of where you choose to eat or drink and literally everyone wants your custom…

Great atmosphere and good fun!

reviews.text: Nguyen Dinh Chieu Walking Street is a short walkway along one side of the Perfume River.  February 3 Park boarders the other side. The street wasn't overly wide. I enjoyed walking along it as you could take in all the sites. It had a great view of the river and the northern banks. The street was smoothly paved which made for an easy, leisurely walk. There were some restaurants and cafes along the street as well as some street food stalls. In the evening, you could do a boat tour of the river.

Everything was perfect. The crowds weren't overwhelming, but there were enough people to make it feel lively. Food, drinks, and entertainment were all reasonably priced, offering great value for money.

The design is beautiful and it’s the best place in Hue to take photos of the river. It’s very clean and well-maintained. Definitely worth a walk if you’re exploring the riverbank.

If you are into running or jogging, it's a great place to go for it. Go early in the morning or late afternoon, to avoid intense heat.

reviews.text:
Came in because of the recommendations. Unfortunately as others have said, the pizza base tastes like a frozen one (nicely cooked, but not like a freshly made dough pizza), two of the three beers I had were a little disappointing (nicely cooked nose but weak on the follow through), and to top it off got charged more than the menu in front of me. Staff were very apologetic, but when they showed me another menu, at least two beers on their menu were marked at a higher price than on the menu they gave me. Luckily I’m gracious… that might not play so well with everyone. Disappointing, because the first beer was good, the tacos weren’t bad and the atmosphere was good. I hope you can pick things up, because there’s a lot of potential.

Postscript: came back at the invitation of the owner, situation nicely rectified. Had another couple of beers, and a nice chat with the owner and the brewer. The Citra Crush was a very nice hazy pale ale. Classy response from the venue… hope to visit again, and maybe get to drink the gose I suggested to the head brewer.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hey Christopher, thanks for coming by and sorry you had a disappointing experience.

About the pizza dough, we kneed out each fresh dough ball on the counter in the middle of the restaurant (it's visible in the 4th picture you posted). It definitely isn't coming out of the freezer.

We update our beer list about twice a week and unfortunately there was a typo on yesterday's English version (but not the Vietnamese version, which is the "other" menu they showed you). The prices on the tap board itself were also the correct ones. The staff should have offered you the price on the menu you received even though it's incorrect. That's on us, and thanks for being gracious about that. We've already talked about this with the bar staff to make sure that any future issues always get settled in the customer's favour. It's our mistake after all.

You're also welcome to taste as many beers as you like before ordering so you can choose something that you're excited to drink. This is printed on the menu as well 😉

If you're still in town today, please come by and have 2 free pints on me. Otherwise, thanks again for visiting and the offer still stands if you ever find yourself in Hue again!

title: Thuận An Beach

reviews.text: If you are looking for the escape of noice and rush of Hue this is the perfect place. Dont expect  services like in resorts, neither cleanless, on some places plastic trash on the beach, but it has its unique charm. No crowds, beautifull peacefull scenery, fishing vilages all arround. You still can get freshly squeezed juice there or something to eat, for us it was perfect half day escape from the heat of Hue.

Thuận An Beach, located just a short drive from the historic city of Huế, is a hidden gem along Vietnam’s central coast. Unlike the busier beaches further south, it offers a tranquil escape with soft golden sands stretching along the shoreline and gentle waves lapping at the shore. The beach is ideal for early morning strolls, sunrise photography, or simply soaking in the peaceful coastal atmosphere.

The surrounding area features local fishing villages, giving visitors a glimpse into the authentic daily life of Vietnamese coastal communities. Seafood here is fresh and plentiful, with small beachside eateries serving simple yet delicious dishes. The atmosphere remains relaxed even during weekends, making it a great spot for photographers seeking natural light, reflections in the water, and unobstructed horizon shots.

For travelers, Thuận An Beach is easily accessible by motorbike, taxi, or private car from Huế city center, and parking is straightforward. Facilities are modest but sufficient, including local stalls for refreshments and shaded areas to rest. The beach is also safe for swimming, with lifeguards present in certain sections during peak season.

Photographers will appreciate the wide-open spaces, scenic dunes, and occasional fishing boats that create compelling foregrounds. Sunrise and sunset provide excellent lighting conditions for capturing the serene beauty of the area, while the nearby lagoon adds variety to landscape compositions.

Overall, Thuận An Beach is a peaceful and photogenic coastal retreat that offers both natural beauty and cultural authenticity. It’s perfect for those looking to escape the crowds and enjoy a calm, scenic Vietnamese beach experience.

Don't let the negative reviews fool you! I found this beach to be incredibly serene and clean. The water was surprisingly clear, and I didn't encounter any trash at all. Maybe it depends on the season, but it was perfect when I was there.

This beach is a serene coastal destination in Thua Thien Hue Province, roughly 15 kilometers east of Hue city center. Known as the "muse of Hue," it is uniquely situated where the Perfume River flows into the Tam Giang Lagoon and out to the East Sea.
It was a beautiful beach resort on this Thuan An beach called Lapochine beach resort (formerly Ana mandara hue), and we stayed there for 12 nights but sadly this beach front resort is permanently closed 😥 and I can't write a review anymore. So I'm sharing some pictures of our stay on the Thuan an beach Hue. This beach offers a more authentic, tranquil local experience compared to busier tourist hubs like Da Nang. Features approximately 10km of coastline with soft golden sand and clear blue waters. Popular for swimming, watching local fishermen, and enjoying fresh, affordable seafood at shorefront stalls.

If you come here around the end of march a bit after 1 pm the entire beach and village around is a ghost town. Empty restaurants, empty beach … the locals will be mainly sleeping around but if you wake them up they can make you some food and serve you drinks. The beach itself is a bit dirty but you need to walk to the right toward the Little Hawai where the beach is better and the aforementioned cafe bar is actually very nice.

reviews.text:
I don't wish to sound too negative, as we had a nice relaxing time, to a point.

The place is marketed as a 'beach club' and in our experience a beach club has comfortable loungers around a pool, sun shade, music and of course food and drinks.
The first thing that shocked us when we arrived.... zero sun shade....There is not a single umbrella or sunshade anywhere around the pool and coming from Australia where skin cancer is common, we were forced to sit in the direct sunshine.
We paid the entrance fee 150k VND per person and if you want to use the pool, you must pay another 100k VND.... Sorry, but at a beach club anywhere in the world, this is ridiculous, you are going there for the pool and ambiance, why is there an extra fee (abelit very cheap) to use the pool?

I do not have an issue paying an entrance fee, especially when you get 100% back in food and beverage, but as I detailed above, no sunshade, extra fee to cool off in the pool, no music.... I just feel it wasn't good enough for a 5 stars review.

Great beach bar in town. A gateway for you who wants to close by the beach, enjoy your drink and swim. The beach is quiet clear and clean, it is private area therefore it is super chill. There is also a pool.
The entrance fee was 150k/person (it was Tet holiday so price is up, I think could be cheaper) then you will use that coupon to buy your drink and pay top up if you order sth over your coupon. I think it is win win for everyone. Cant ask for more, the service is also great, very friendly and attentive

We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful beach setting, pool facilities, and overall relaxing atmosphere. It’s especially rewarding to know that our team’s service made a positive impression—we truly appreciate your kind words and will share them with our staff.

We also appreciate your understanding regarding the holiday pricing during Tết. We’re glad the entrance voucher system added value to your experience.

It was our pleasure to have you with us at Beach Bar Hue, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another enjoyable visit in the future.

Team Beach Bar Hue with Love

reviews.text:
A place that shimmered with promise—
but asked too much at the door.
150,000 dong just to step inside,
another 100,000 to touch the water—
even the pool kept its distance.
And water, that simplest of freedoms,
was not yours to carry in.
Inside, the prices told their own story—
not for the wanderer, but the passing gaze.
120,000 dong for a moment in a glass,
gone as quickly as it came.
Some places welcome you in—
others simply take.
This one, I’d leave behind.

We ended up here when the bar we tried to get to didn't seem to exist anymore. We had seen this place on the map but weren't sure if we could use it without being guests of the hotel. The staff were perfectly happy with this (we approached from the beach side). It was beautiful, very tranquil and quiet. There's no marked swimming area (we went in the sea and didn't die, but take sensible precautions) and the sand is very hot, but the drinks were cold, the staff were friendly (only a little English was spoken but everyone was happy and patient) and there was a clean western style toilet.

reviews.text:
A fantastic Japanese-style cocktail bar with the level of precision and craftsmanship you would expect. From the mixologists in elegant two- and three-piece suits to the exacting way both classics and signatures are prepared and served, everything feels deliberate and refined.

My wife ordered a simple Amaretto Sour, which was anything but simple — made with fresh egg whites and house-made bitters, it was incredibly creamy and perfectly balanced. I had the Ikigai: coffee-infused gin topped with matcha foam. Truly exceptional and unlike anything I’ve had before.

The only disappointment was that foreign credit cards were not accepted, which limited us to one round as we were short on cash. That aside, these are the best cocktails I’ve had in Vietnam so far, without question.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Otto, for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. We’re truly happy to know that you and your wife enjoyed the cocktails, the service, and the attention to detail — that’s exactly the spirit we aim to bring to every guest.

We’d just like to clarify one small detail: the bitters used in the Amaretto Sour are not house-made. We simply transfer them into small dropper bottles to ensure easier handling and precise dosing during service.

We also appreciate your note regarding payment, and it’s something we’re taking seriously as we work to improve the overall experience.

We hope to welcome you back again soon — and next time, please let us know, we’d be more than happy to prepare a few more special drinks for you. Wishing you a wonderful time in Vietnam.
#cocktail #bestcocktail #hue #chill #date #cocktailbar #japanesestyle

Knowing that our cocktails could almost win over a non-drinker is truly one of the best compliments we could receive. We'd love to welcome you back whenever your journey brings you to Hue again.

reviews.text:
I came here alone after a long day, and I’m really glad I got to meet Xiao Liang and Kris, the bartenders. They were both incredibly friendly and chatty, and I had such a great time talking with them.

The vibe here is great. I loved the cocktails and the music, and the whole place felt relaxed and cozy. It wasn’t too loud, which made it easy to sit back and enjoy the evening.

I also had the chance to chat with the owner, who introduced me to a Chinese jasmine tequila called General. I had never heard of it before, but it tasted really good.

The owner even gave me a sample of a smoked Scotch whisky mixed with oolong tea. It tasted so fresh and perfectly balanced not too strong and not overly smoky. Such a unique and delicious combination.

I had a really good time here and would highly recommend this place, especially if you’re looking for a cozy bar with great drinks, music, and friendly people.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your thoughtful review! We’re truly happy that Xiao Liang and Kris made your evening special, and that you enjoyed our cocktails, music, and cozy atmosphere. It means a lot to us that you appreciated our unique drinks and the stories behind them. We hope to welcome you back to Drowsy again soon!

reviews.text: Fantastic cocktails and an excellent overall experience. It’s clear that a great deal of creativity and thought has gone into the signature cocktail menu, with each drink feeling unique and carefully crafted. The atmosphere, service, and attention to detail all contribute to making this a place well worth visiting. I would highly recommend it.

Thừa Thiên Huế is a beautiful place full of history, culture, and a peaceful atmosphere. The city has a unique charm with its ancient architecture, especially the Imperial City, temples, and traditional Vietnamese landscapes.

What I liked most is that Huế feels much calmer and more authentic compared to bigger tourist cities. The people are friendly, the food is amazing, and there are many beautiful places to explore around the area. The combination of history, nature, rivers, and local life makes Huế a very special destination.

A great place for travelers who want to experience a different side of Vietnam — less rushed, more cultural, and full of character.

title: Le Cercle Rooftop Bar
ownerDescription: Enjoy the breathtaking panoramic views of Huế from Le Cercle Rooftop Bar. With a curated selection of classic cocktails and exquisite drinks, Le Cercle Rooftop Bar is an unmissable destination for your visit to Huế.
address: 11 Lê Lợi, Thuận Hóa, Huế 530000, Vietnam

reviews.text:
If you are looking for a charming spot to unwind and enjoy a delightful atmosphere, Le Cercle Sportif Bar in Hue is a must-visit. Nestled alongside the picturesque Perfume River, this bar offers stunning views that enhance the overall experience.

On a warm day, the gentle breeze blowing through the area adds a refreshing touch, making it an ideal place to relax. The happy hour specials are fantastic, providing a perfect opportunity to sip on creative cocktails while soaking in the scenery.

The food options are equally enticing, offering a variety of delicious bites that complement the vibrant atmosphere. Whether you're there for a casual meet-up with friends or a quick stop to recharge, Le Cercle Sportif Bar is the perfect getaway. Don't miss the chance to enjoy this hidden gem, it is abplace that captures the essence of leisure by the river.

Lovely rooftop cocktail bar. The location is amazing, looking out over the river. And the cocktails are fantastic. I got their variation on a Negroni, made with Vietnamese medicinal wine & it was delicious. Highly recommended!

Came here for drinks and got served by Mo. She has such a beautiful personality! She smiled and welcomed us as soon as we stepped foot in the bar. Mo & the staff here went above and beyond to accommodate our preference. Plus, they made delicious cocktails! Thanks again Mo for giving us a great experience!
Fantastic place to watch the sun go down. Easy access and a great location on the river. Good cocktails between $6-9 AUD.

Nestled on the Huong river, Rooftopbar offers breathtaking panoramic views — especially magical at sunset or under the evening lights. The decor is stylish and modern, creating a relaxed yet upscale atmosphere ideal for both date nights and social gatherings.

The cocktail menu is creative and well-executed, with both classics and house specials made with care. Their small plates are also thoughtfully curated, with fresh ingredients and a gourmet touch. The staff are friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about the experience they provide.

a must-visit for anyone looking to enjoy great drinks, sophisticated vibes, and one of the best views in town. Highly recommended for locals and tourists alike.
We enjoyed a drink at sunset here. It is a great spot, very relaxing and comfortable chairs. A good selection of drinks. The pricing was really good for the quality of the bar.
